notes.title: Season 1 — 5 new languages + fixes
notes.content:
Hello, everyone! 

This update adds full support for five new languages and multiple bugfixes.

[h3]What's new[/h3]
[list]
[*] New languages added: Arabic, Czech, Portuguese, Brazilian Portuguese, Hungarian.
[*] Localization covers the interface, the subtitles, and other in-game text.
[*] Fixes and improvements: improved stability, fixed visual/textual glitches, as well as the game logic in some quests, photo transfer from the phone to Season 2 now works properly.
[/list]
If you have any feedback regarding localization, please let us know in the Discussions forum on Steam.

[b]As always, thank you for your support![/b]

[b]Season 2 is now fully released (v1.0)[/b]
If you already own Season 1, the bundle price on the store page will automatically adjust with [i]Complete the Set[/i] pricing.

notes.title: Knightly Passions by FEYADA : Steam Release !!!
notes.content:
Yesterday, our friends at [b]Team FEYADA released their game, Knightly Passions, on Steam[/b]. The game is available to be picked up now at a great price! Hurry while the discount lasts!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1554260/Knightly_Passions

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41385322/ed5277aa00725c36afe18cabff58ac99ce873e44.jpg[/img]


[b]”Knightly Passions” is a nonlinear visual novel with RPG elements [/b] that brings together the very best aspects of the genre. In it, you alone can decide how to act in challenging situations, who to consider a friend or enemy, and how to interact with any given character. And it is up to you alone to become the greatest warrior and champion of a downtrodden world!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41385322/652887078b036220404aa44c2638dec2280f32c0.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41385322/ca945d814536f466146967dba1d2dd66234f6642.png[/img]

[i]In addition to combat encounters, players will encounter open-world challenges. You’ll not only face a diverse array of traps and puzzles, but also a host of different interactive minigames designed to add variety to gameplay.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41385322/da6976ea9b8c82dc951a1463dde3e564de90edfd.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41385322/2f8ec9af6ac16adf0c60a94cc4506228447e13c8.png[/img]

An excellent addition to all of the above is the abundance of splendid ladies, including a [b]Vampire, Witch, Elf, Werewolf, Arachnid, and so on[/b]. Building relationships with these beauties also takes quite some time, and the result will be[b] horny scenes[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41385322/221759a4ebd6c5e0408acac88951b65ae9ebb957.png[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41385322/eecc565e8cea17660a426de46bcc38fb617fca39.png[/img]

[b]Don't forget to leave reviews! The [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1554260/Knightly_Passions/]Knightly Passions[/url] devs have worked really hard to make sure you enjoy the game.[/b]

notes.title: STEAM AWARDS 2023 nominate us!
notes.content:
Embark on an exhilarating gaming journey with  [b]MILFs of Sunville[/b]!

Enjoy the Steam Autumn Sale, spanning from November 21st to November 28th, and seize the opportunity to acquire our game at an exclusive price.

But that's not all –  [b]become an integral part of gaming history[/b]  by casting your vote for MILFs of Sunville in the prestigious  [b]Steam Awards[/b].

As the categories for Steam Awards encompass achievements such as 'Game of the Year,' 'Best Story,' 'Best Graphics,' 'Best Atmosphere,' 'Best Music,' 'Best Multiplayer,' and more, your vote holds the power to influence the game's standing in these aspects.

This event is about more than just discounted prices; it's an opportunity for each fan to make a lasting impact. Your engagement during the Steam Awards is another way to provide valuable insights and feedback from you, our dear fans, that shape the trajectory of MILFs of Sunville's future development.

[b]Every gamer and fan of MILFs of Sunville plays a pivotal role in this journey.[/b]

Your votes in the Steam Awards not only determine the winners but also contribute to the ongoing success and improvement of our game. The voice of each of our players can sway the decisions influencing the direction we take in enhancing and expanding the MILFs of Sunville experience.

Join us in this exciting venture during the Steam Autumn Sale, cast your vote in the Steam Awards, and let's collectively make MILFs of Sunville a standout success.

Let's make history together!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41385322/48e4d0d5cd37e56913fdc8cb30f61b717af73192.png[/img]

notes.title: MILFs of Sunville: v7 has been released!
notes.content:
Hello, L7Team here!
We’re happy to present you with the latest [b]regular update[/b] for [b]"MILFs of Sunville"[/b]!
As always, we’ve worked really hard to get this quality update released on time.
It contains more than [b]1300 new images[/b] and [b]many cool animations[/b].

We hope you thoroughly enjoy spending time with your favorite characters in this new update!
Your feedback is very important to us and we do everything in our power to keep the usual quality bar and the regularity of updates!
We’re thrilled to be working on this project so expect more exciting cool content to come!

[h2]Improvements:[/h2]
[list]
[*] In-game gallery added. You can now see what events you missed and re-watch the events you’ve already completed.
[*] Bug Fixes.
[/list]
[h2]Supported languages:[/h2]
[list]
[*] English
[*] German
[*] French
[*] Italian
[*] Spanish
[*] Turkish
[*] Chinese
[*] Ukrainian
[*] Russian
[/list]
P.S.
As you may know, the game’s status is currently "in Early Access". According to Steam’s rules, when we first started developing the game, we had to set a date when the game is expected to come out of that state. We settled there for one year of development.
According to that prior agreement, the game must get a full-fledged release soon. 
As you can probably guess, the game is still in development and we plan to create a ton of new cool content for you guys, but we also don’t want to break Steam’s ToS, so we decided to split the game into "seasons" with the first one coming to an end and after the next 3-4 updates. Season 2 will be a separate game.
Not to worry, though! There are still a number of updates planned for Season 1 with plenty of things to enjoy. Also, by the end of it, some of the main storylines will be resolved, for example the one involving Sophie.
As always, thank you for your continuous support!
We’ll do our very best to keep up with the regular update schedule and bring you even more quality content in the future!
